overall_summary: The performance data is extremely small (all videos have single-digit views), so confidence is very low. Most hooks revolved around phone numbers, blocks, or late nights, showing lack of diverse pattern testing.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos referencing phone numbers and contact names generated slightly higher relative visibility (e.g., 'आज भी फोन में तुम्हारा नाम सुरक्षित है' got 9 views).
winning_patterns.action: Continue referencing everyday digital habits like typing and deleting unsent messages.

weak_patterns.evidence: Hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' yielded the lowest views (4 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic time-based openings and focus on tangible physical moments.

next_video.reason: Tests a fresh physical typing action rather than phone numbers or late night clichés during peak evening engagement hours.

experiment: Testing an action-based digital habit (typing and deleting text) instead of status/number-based hooks.
